bio.text: Steven Meeks, a Republican, represents Georgia House District 178.
He worked for more than twelve years for U.S. Senator Saxby Chambliss, including as legislative director for the Senate Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition and Forestry and as state director.
In 2010 he moved to Wayne County to join the family business Burch Farms, and he also operates his own business, Nine Run Farms.
He graduated from the University of Georgia College of Agriculture and Environmental Sciences and lives in Screven.
